title: It must be possible to rate an Agent's run
description:
The rating can be a number - and we also want to allow comments for this. The rating information should also contain the date when it was given.

This is a rating that will be added to an Agent's run that already happened - so it is tied to the HistoryService.
This has no implication on projects, stories or features.

features.title: Update agent run data model with rating information
features.description: In `src/agentRunStore.ts`, define a new type `AgentRunRating` which includes `score` (number), `comment` (string, optional), and `createdAt` (Date). Then, add an optional `rating` property of type `AgentRunRating` to the `AgentRunHistory` interface.

features.title: Implement `rateRun` method in AgentRunStore
features.description: In `src/agentRunStore.ts`, add a new method `rateRun` to the `AgentRunStore` implementation. This method should accept a `runId` and a rating object. It will read the corresponding run history file, add the rating information (including the current date for `createdAt`), and write the updated history back to the file. Ensure the method is added to the `AgentRunStore` interface as well.
